_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. Edit this file to change the brand, number, menu and prices everywhere (landing page + WhatsApp bot read it). All prices are in Naira (NGN). The bot reads this same file at ../landing/config.json.

business.name: Sokoto Tasty Kitchen
business._name_note: SAMPLE NAME — replace with your real business name.
business.tagline: Hot, tasty meals delivered anywhere in Sokoto
business.locationNote: Inside/near Usmanu Danfodiyo University Teaching Hospital (UDUTH)
business._whatsapp_note: PLACEHOLDER — the business WhatsApp number in full international format, digits only, no + (e.g. 2347012345678). This is the number customers chat and the bot runs on.
business._ownerNotify_note: PLACEHOLDER — YOUR personal number (digits only, no +). The bot sends new-order alerts here. Keep it different from the business number above.

hours.label: Open daily, 9:00am – 9:00pm
hours._note: 24-hour times. The bot uses open/close to tell customers if you're open now.

delivery.label: ₦1,000 delivery within Sokoto metropolis. Free delivery on orders from ₦15,000.
delivery.note: Exact fee for far areas is confirmed on WhatsApp before you pay.

payment.label: Pay on delivery or bank transfer (sent on WhatsApp after you confirm).
